questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how keys are assigned to nodes on the ring? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A user follows 500 authors spread across 6 feed nodes. How many calls to recentPosts does homeTimeline make?
choices: 1, to the node owning the user's id
At most 6, one per distinct node owning any followed author
Always exactly 6, one per node in the cluster

questions.prompt: Why does each node get 128 virtual points instead of one?
choices: To spread each node's ownership across many small arcs so load is more even and a node's removal spreads its keys over many survivors
To store 128 replicas of every post for durability
So that locate() can be O(1)
To allow keys to be routed to 128 nodes in parallel

questions.prompt: Node C is removed via remove('C'). Which posts can homeTimeline no longer find, assuming no data is moved?
choices: None; the ring re-sorts and finds them elsewhere
Posts by every author, since all routing changes
Only posts published after the removal
Posts previously written to C, because their authors now route to other nodes that never stored them
